drhp.business: Macpower CNC Machines was incorporated in 2003 and makes CNC machine tools in 9 product categories with more than 60 models. It has more than 5,500 installations serving 27 industry segments. Its machines are mainly general-purpose metal-cutting CNC machines with 2 to 3 axes. Its NEXA vertical sells premium, higher-value machines such as VMCs, HMCs and VTLs, largely to defence and Tier 1/2 OEM customers. Its Macatrol CNC controller is supplied by a Taiwanese firm. Its installed capacity is stated as about 2,500 machines per year. It has taken about 13 acres of land (including a 4-acre green zone) on a 30-year lease near Metoda GIDC, Rajkot, Gujarat.

Per the Ken Research Report the India Dies and Moulds Market was valued at INR 45,400 crore in FY'25 and is projected to grow at an 11.5% CAGR to FY'30F, with Automotive Moulds the largest application at INR 25.2 thousand crore in FY'25 and B2B/OEM the dominant distribution channel. themes.title: Capital-goods & machine-tool import-substitution
themes.need: Atmanirbhar machine-tool and heavy-engineering localization is supply-constrained against import-substituting demand. JYOTICNC runs >100% utilization with a INR4,732cr order book and near-triples capacity; ELGIEQUIP/CUMMINSIND/ELECON/LMW ride the same capex + export + China+1 pull; ISGEC/BHEL/GMMPFAUDLR/KIRLPNU on process + energy capex.
themes.driver: Capacity expansion going live (JYOTICNC); defence/EMS order conversion; US-reshoring export demand (ELGIEQUIP).
